bills.title: Northern Australia Infrastructure Facility Amendment (Extension and Other Measures) Bill 2021

name: The majority voted against a series of [amendments](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-05-13.116.1) introduced by the Australian Greens, which means they failed. The amendments can be found on sheets [1268](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6670_amend_2ed7021c-abea-4f7d-a435-a5cb632e6860%22;rec=0), [1278](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6670_amend_fe30aedb-0f58-4925-883e-e8aaa68de92f%22;rec=0), [1280](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6670_amend_86e36e77-79c5-456b-9997-b7b6001dcbe2%22;rec=0), [1281](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6670_amend_1612cfb3-0bc3-4601-9268-ad5bea4bb225%22;rec=0), [1282](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6670_amend_c3520058-1d37-4641-ae85-2c9f41cb362b%22;rec=0) and [1287](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6670_amend_216d7a67-26b1-426a-acef-23290caabeff%22;rec=0). ### What does the bill do?
